_meta.description: Multi-source latent ideology evidence for 30 French news outlets. Evidence split into direct indicators (measure latent ideology z_i) and structural priors (predict prior on z_i). Null = not applicable, not missing.
_meta.architecture: Two-step approximation of latent measurement model: (1) z-score each direct family, (2) average available z-scores per outlet, (3) shrink toward structural prior for sparse outlets, (4) re-standardize blended scores to zero-mean, unit-variance across the 30-outlet panel.

D3.label: Network ideology (hyperlink + Twitter cluster position)
D3.source: Cointet et al. (2021). Uncovering the structure of the French media ecosystem. IC2S2 preprint. HAL halshs-03299024. Cross-validated with: Fondation Descartes / Graphika (2020). Visualization of the new political-media landscape in France [Twitter, Dec 2019–Jan 2020]. Institut Montaigne media taxonomy (Heart/Crown/Satellite, cited in Fondation Descartes report p.3).
D3.scale: Block assignment from Stochastic Block Model on hyperlink network, cross-validated with Twitter cluster proximity. Numeric encoding: Left Wing=-2, Mainstream(Hyper-centre/Centre)=0, Right Wing=+2, Identitarian Right=+3. Mainstream=0 because mainstream outlets receive links from all political camps — network position is ideologically AMBIGUOUS within the mainstream; D3=0 for mainstream outlets adds no direct ideology information but does not contradict other signals.
D3.coverage: All 25 outlets. Note: Blast founded 2021 (after Cointet 2018-19 data) — block inferred from editorial characteristics. Periphery outlets (CNews in medias.csv) receive null D3 from Cointet hyperlink data; right-wing assignment for CNews is sourced from Fondation Descartes Twitter analysis (2019-20) instead.
D3.interpretation_rule: Cointet medias.csv wheel_subcategory maps to left-right as follows: 'Left Wing' (Opinion Journalism block) → -2.0; 'Hyper-centre' or 'Centre' (Mainstream Media block) → 0.0; 'Right Wing' (Opinion Journalism block) → +2.0; 'Identitarian' (Counter-Informational Space) → +3.0; 'Periphery' (network position pre-dates political reformat or lacks political placement) → null. Justification: Cointet et al. derive these blocks via SBM on the French hyperlink network; political parties and partisan outlets cluster in the Left/Right blocks by definition of the SBM communities. The numeric mapping preserves their empirically-derived political ordering.

D7.label: Content-based ideology score (D7)
D7.source: Derived from two sampled article corpora (2023-H2 and 2024-H1). Symmetric endorsed majority-voting is applied to both left and right vocabularies: article-level signal for a side requires non-distanced occurrences to outnumber distanced occurrences, using guillemets, distancing prefixes, and side-specific critique vocabulary.
D7.scale: Per-period D7 = (right_signal_articles - left_signal_articles) / (right_signal + left). Final D7 = mean of 2023-H2 and 2024-H1 when both periods are available. Range: -1 (all left) to +1 (all right).
D7.period: 2023-H2 (Jul-Dec 2023) and 2024-H1 (Jan-Jun 2024). canonical_category = politique. Max 1,000 articles per (outlet, month) bucket.
D7.coverage: 22 of 25 outlets. Null: Mediapart, Blast, Slate.fr (insufficient signal after symmetric endorsed filtering, n<10).
D7.known_limitations: Lexical scoring still right-shifts some center-left paper-of-record outlets because neutral reporting and endorsement remain imperfectly separable from local lexical context alone; the method is therefore used as one family within the multi-source fusion model rather than a standalone classifier.
D7.uncertainty: medium — lexical method, validated against final_score_z from the multi-family model

structural.S3_src: Criminal court records. Encoding: 0.2 × 1 = 0.2. 1 confirmed criminal conviction documented by web search 2026-06-01: ~2012 Tribunal correctionnel de Paris — provocation publique à la discrimination raciale; €5,000 fine (vimy-notaires.fr/condamnations-de-fdesouche-bilan-des-affaires-judiciaires/). 2nd potential conviction (~2015, apologie du terrorisme, €10,000) found in single third-party source (vimy-notaires.fr) but NOT cross-verified against primary court records — not counted until verified.
